historical_evidence.finding: Labeling audit: OTHER PPP inflated by foul endings (36%); DRIVE 12pp below foul benchmark; only 335 of 50,668 possessions (0.7%) map to a real play type via initiation_type. Verdict: artifact_found.

Global lag lifts for play-type action memory were flat and non-decaying; they disappeared after team-season demeaning. Within-team memory was essentially null except SPOT_UP lag-1. Mechanism: C_artifact. DRIVE lag-1 n=163,696.
Decay-sanity gate failed: DRIVE lifts flat across lags (+0.015 to +0.021); within-team lag-1 ranged +0.015 to -0.002; d about 0.01-0.03 with n>150k; team-quality confound. Verdict: failed_gate.

Downstream opponent next-PPP component: 4 of 8 play types real (CUT +0.0220, TRANSITION +0.0145, SPOT_UP +0.0124, POST_UP +0.0194); DRIVE not real. Player-level effects mostly non-significant after BH. Mechanism E_unclear; effects about 0.01-0.02 PPP.
52-series playoff test: durable_branches empty; median net swing CUT +0.36, TRANSITION +0.26, POST_UP -0.22, DRIVE -0.27 across 104 units. Mechanism B_powered_null.
Net-swing prototype changed top recommendation in 40 of 104 units (38%); not evaluated against outcomes; verdict descriptive.

Defensive aftershock present in 8/8 PTs and replicated across all-games and playoffs (CUT +0.119, n=21,398; PO +0.131, n=1,145). Outcome metric not stated in the retrieved summary. Mechanism D_positive; limited by small_sample.
On-ball scheme labels: 14.9% (DET, 10 of 67) and 3.3% (ORL, 2 of 60) labeled; switches_on unpopulated. Mechanism A_unanswerable.
Star-initiator lineup and forced-play-type PPP gaps with no placebo or matching; later work treated similar gaps as artifacts. Risk PLACEBO_DEPENDENCE.
Brown-to-Tatum next-possession ATT -0.0165, CI [-0.0924, +0.0605]; real ATT inside placebo range; sign flips across quarters and season types.

evidence_establishes: Play-type labels from initiation_type are not valid in this graph: 0.7% coverage and foul-ending distortion (FAM:SF-CHT-025).
Global own-sequence lifts were team-quality artifacts; within-team memory is essentially null except SPOT_UP lag-1 (FAM:SF-APPS-073, FAM:SF-CHT-029).
Opponent next-PPP effects where estimated are small, about 0.01-0.02 PPP (FAM:SF-APPS-075).

evidence_does_not_establish: Any numeric threshold for large enough to drive AVOID labels; no retrieved record defines the AVOID label.

Power for 2025-26 cells is not recorded.
Whether initiation_type mapping has been fixed since SF-CHT-025 is unknown.
Only the retrieved summaries were used; read_family was not called.

historical_effect.explanation: Retrieval showed the play-type labels failed audit (SF-CHT-025), own-sequence lifts were confounding artifacts (SF-APPS-073, SF-CHT-029), and opponent effects are small (SF-APPS-075). This moved the decision from proceed to proceed_with_changes: validate labels and fix the AVOID threshold before testing effects.

blocking_constraints.text: AVOID labels built from opponent next-PPP make the test circular unless the label is defined from pre-period information or held out.
initiation_type maps only 0.7% of 50,668 possessions; foul endings inflate OTHER PPP by 36%.
Global lifts collapsed under within-team demeaning (SF-APPS-073, SF-CHT-029).
Playoff and small play-type cells are thin; SF-APPS-049 and SF-APPS-075 needed BH correction and found few real cells.
Player and lineup cells in SF-CHT-009 and SF30 have n of about 30-60 with CIs spanning zero.

prior_work.summary: Downstream opponent next-PPP effects were measured and found small (SF-APPS-075). Own-sequence lags were mostly team-quality artifacts (SF-APPS-073, SF-CHT-029). Net-swing scoring was prototyped without outcome validation (SF-APPM-011). No retrieved record defines or validates an AVOID label, and the labeling step itself failed audit (SF-CHT-025), so the AVOID-threshold question remains open.

risks.text: AVOID labels built from opponent next-PPP make label and outcome the same quantity; the test would be circular.
Play-type labels failed audit (0.7% coverage, foul leakage).
Whole-season team baselines leak future information into per-possession estimates.
Team quality, score margin and lineup drive both play selection and opponent next-PPP; SF-CHT-029 shows this.
Foul and turnover endings have play-type-dependent floors that can mimic AVOID-level effects.
Many play-type by opponent cells have low outcome base rates, so large differences can be rare-event artifacts.
Many play types, lags and players produce many candidate labels; SF-APPS-075 needed BH correction.
Star and sequence effects held only partly against placebo, and signs flipped across quarters and season types (SF-CHT-009, SF30).
Playoff and player-level cells are small; CIs in SF30 span zero.
Seasons 2022-23 to 2025-26 differ in pace and rules; a pooled threshold may not hold, and 2025-26 playoffs are partial.
initiation_type failed audit, so other mapping errors in the graph's play-type records are possible and unaudited.
SF07 aftershock and SF-APPS-075 downstream metrics may not measure the same quantity.

design.estimand: Difference in opponent next-possession PPP after a team runs play X, relative to a within-team, score-state-matched baseline, compared with a pre-registered AVOID threshold; own-sequence lag-1 to lag-3 effects are secondary.
design.unit: Team-offense possession, with the opponent's next possession as outcome, nested in team-season and game.
design.sample: Regular seasons 2022-23 to 2024-25 and the 2025-26 regular season (complete from 2026-04-13). Playoffs 2022-23 to 2024-25 only; 2025-26 playoffs excluded until complete (from 2026-06-21). Foul- and unlabeled-ending possessions excluded from the primary analysis and reported separately.
design.power: Compute minimum detectable effect per play-type cell before fitting, using the about 150k per-lag counts in SF-APPS-073. Primary test limited to cells with at least 5,000 possessions; cells below 1,000 reported without inference.
design.controls: Team-season fixed effects; score-margin and game-state strata; lineup or opponent-defense strata where coverage allows; own-team lags 1-3 as covariates; baseline built only from prior seasons to avoid leakage. Report direct PPP and opponent next-PPP separately.
design.falsification: Placebo play types or shuffled opponent sequences must show no effect; a real effect must survive within-team demeaning and must not appear in the placebo baseline.
design.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across play types and lags, with a pre-registered primary family (opponent next-PPP, lag-1) to limit false positives.
design.decision_rule: An AVOID label is supported only if the opponent next-PPP effect exceeds the pre-registered threshold after demeaning, survives the placebo, and passes BH. Otherwise report artifact or uncertain.
design.data_version: Per-game NBA stats API files for 2022-23 to 2025-26 as available on 2026-06-19, with the initiation_type mapping audited and corrected before analysis.
